war_summary: War 139 is on day 119 with no winner yet (32 victory towns required), and the map remains heavily consolidated in rear areas — Colonials fully hold Acrithia, Dead Lands, Drowned Vale, Fisherman's Row and many others; Wardens fully hold Basin Sionnach, Clanshead Valley, Viper Pit, Reaching Trail and Weathered Expanse — while a handful of contested fronts drive nearly all activity. Compared to the prior snapshot (~3h ago), Endless Shore remains the largest battle: 8-2 Colonial now, ~53 events/24h with an event minutes before cutoff, and casualty rates have re-accelerated sharply (~750-850/hr per side over 2h windows) after a cooling phase. Oarbreaker stays extremely active (39 events/24h at Grisly Refuge, Posterus, Integrum; latest event ~3h old) though its 2h rates have cooled sharply from a mid-period spike; Wardens hold 9-0. Clahstra continues escalating dramatically — casualty rates have roughly tripled again (~1050-1600/hr per side over 2h) with events around Transept, Weephome and East Narthex, currently 6-2 Warden. Marban Hollow is surging hard (~565-600/hr per side over 2h, ~1900 enlistments/24h, events at Sanctum ~8h ago, 5-3 Warden). Onyx has reignited with heavy casualties (~500-640/hr over 2h) and recent activity at The Waif, now split 3-3. Godcrofts remains a knife-fight (25 events/24h at Saegio/Argosa, latest event ~2.7h old, 5-3-1 Colonial-leaning split) but its short-term rates are cooling. StemaLanding is newly active with 15 events/24h at The Flair and Verge Wing, latest event minutes before cutoff, 8-1 Colonial. Speaking Woods shows very high attrition (~660-690/hr over 2h) but no events in ~12h; Callahan's Passage shows massive sustained losses (~10k/24h each side) with no events in ~15h. Quiet rear hexes remain static.
